get.description: Probe the session without triggering a 401 (the SPA's first call).

post.description:
End the session now; revoke its tokens after the response, when
configured, so a slow Keystone never delays the logout.

get.description: All of the project's risks in one call; the SPA joins by resource.

schema.title: Response Profile Api Me Profile Get

post.description: The new password is in this reply only, once.

get.description:
The browser's address as the ingress reports it (uvicorn reads
X-Forwarded-For from ``HIVE_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS``), for the rule form's
"Use my address".

schema.title: Response Restore Backup Api Volumes Backups  Backup Id  Restore Post

post.description:
Horizon creates the project's EC2 pair the first time it is viewed
(``api_access/views.py:42-69``).

delete.description: Delete a container; ``with_objects`` empties it first.

schema.title: Response Upload Plan Api Object Store Containers  Container  Upload Plan Post

get.description:
Send the browser to a signed Swift URL, or stream the object when
the store has no TempURL support.

put.description: Stream a file through the backend into Swift (proxy mode).

Accepted.title: Accepted
Accepted.description: A request the upstream accepted and carries out later (a 202).

AccessRule.title: AccessRule
AccessRule.description: A Keystone access rule, passed through as Keystone returns it.

ActionResult.title: ActionResult
ActionResult.description: A server action Nova accepted; only a snapshot names its image.

AddInterfaceResult.title: AddInterfaceResult
AddInterfaceResult.description:
An interface the router took; ``ip_address`` is None when the
address could not be read back.

Affiliation.title: Affiliation
Affiliation.description: An affiliation the My Details form offers.

AllocationLinks.title: AllocationLinks
AllocationLinks.description: Where Horizon's allocation request forms live.

AllocationQuota.title: AllocationQuota
AllocationQuota.description: One resource's quota in the allocation, and its zone.

AllocationSummary.title: AllocationSummary
AllocationSummary.description:
The home page's allocation card: the current allocation, its
quotas by resource code and its SU budget and use. ``-1`` means an
unlimited budget; ``su_used`` is ``None`` when CloudKitty could not
be asked.

AllocationUsage.title: AllocationUsage
AllocationUsage.description:
The burn-down of the current allocation's SU budget. When it
cannot be drawn (no allocation, no or unlimited budget, CloudKitty
down) ``available`` is false, ``reason`` says why and the burn-down
fields are ``None``.

AllowedAddressPair.title: AllowedAddressPair
AllowedAddressPair.description:
An extra address a port may send from: an IP address or a CIDR,
and optionally a MAC address (the port's own when left out).

AllowedAddressPairs.title: AllowedAddressPairs
AllowedAddressPairs.description:
Every allowed address pair the port keeps; Neutron stores them as
one list, so adding or deleting one sends the list that remains.

ApiCredentials.title: ApiCredentials
ApiCredentials.description: What an openrc or clouds.yaml needs about the user and project.

ApplicationCredentialCreated.title: ApplicationCredentialCreated
ApplicationCredentialCreated.description: The create reply: the only one that ever carries the secret.

ApplicationCredentialOptions.title: ApplicationCredentialOptions
ApplicationCredentialOptions.description:
What the create form needs: the token's role names, the prefilled
expiry date and the openrc details.

AssociateFloatingIp.title: AssociateFloatingIp
AssociateFloatingIp.description:
Associate a floating IP with the instance; without ``port_id`` it
goes to the first port that has a fixed IP.

AttachInterface.title: AttachInterface
AttachInterface.description: A new interface on a network, or an existing port; exactly one.

AttachablePort.title: AttachablePort
AttachablePort.description: A port an instance may be attached to, its addresses as strings.

AvailabilityZone.title: AvailabilityZone
AvailabilityZone.description:
A Nova or Cinder availability zone and whether it is up; shared by
the compute and volume replies.

BurnDownGuidePoint.title: BurnDownGuidePoint
BurnDownGuidePoint.description:
An end of the guide line, from zero at the start to the budget at
the end of the allocation.

BurnDownPoint.title: BurnDownPoint
BurnDownPoint.description: The SU used up to ``date``; ``None`` for days after today.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description:
What the user may do here. ``services`` maps each panel's service
key (``hive.services.me.SERVICE_KEYS``) to whether the project's
catalog has it.

ChainState.title: ChainState
ChainState.description:
Progress of the wizard's chained creation (listener, pool, members,
monitor), which Hive runs in the background after the load balancer.
``started`` is epoch seconds; ``failed_step`` is set once the chain
has stopped early.

Cluster.title: Cluster
Cluster.description: A cluster, with the row ``actions`` its status allows.

ClusterCertificate.title: ClusterCertificate
ClusterCertificate.description: A certificate Magnum signed for the cluster, PEM encoded.

ClusterConfig.title: ClusterConfig
ClusterConfig.description:
A kubeconfig with embedded admin credentials, plus the key, CA and
certificate as separate files; the three are ``None`` when the
cluster's template disables TLS.

ClusterCreate.title: ClusterCreate
ClusterCreate.description:
The Nectar create workflow: name, template by version/zone/driver,
sizes and flavours, optional etcd volume, and the key pair and worker
autoscaling the Nectar form had removed.

ClusterFlavor.title: ClusterFlavor
ClusterFlavor.description: A Nova flavour the create workflow offers, by name.

ClusterOptions.title: ClusterOptions
ClusterOptions.description:
What the create cluster workflow needs: the version, zone and
driver pickers, the templates behind them, the flavours, the control
plane sizes and the quota.

ClusterQuota.title: ClusterQuota
ClusterQuota.description:
The project's cluster count and node count against Magnum's
cluster quota (``hard_limit``).

ClusterTemplate.title: ClusterTemplate
ClusterTemplate.description:
A cluster template. ``kubernetes_version``, ``availability_zone``
and ``template_version`` come from the Nectar template name
(``kubernetes-v<version>-<zone>-<driver>-v<template version>``);
``upgrade_targets`` from the ``upgrade_targets`` label.

ComputeLimits.title: ComputeLimits
ComputeLimits.description:
Nova's absolute limits as Nova names them (``maxTotalInstances``,
``totalCoresUsed``); -1 means unlimited.

ConfigurationValues.title: ConfigurationValues
ConfigurationValues.description: ``values`` as strings from the form; coerced by the parameter spec.

ContainerDetail.title: ContainerDetail
ContainerDetail.description:
A container from its ``HEAD``; ``metadata`` is the user metadata
without the CORS origin, which has its own field.

ContainerList.title: ContainerList
ContainerList.description:
The account's containers; ``truncated`` when the listing stopped at
the page cap with more to come.

ContainerUpdate.title: ContainerUpdate
ContainerUpdate.description: An empty metadata value removes the key.

Credential.title: Credential
Credential.description: A generic Keystone credential (TOTP, EC2 or certificate).

CurrentAllocation.title: CurrentAllocation
CurrentAllocation.description:
The project's current approved allocation, as Horizon's
``/rest_api/allocations/`` serialiser sends it.

DatabaseLogAction.title: DatabaseLogAction
DatabaseLogAction.description: The action to take on a guest log (``logs/tables.py``).

DatastoreOption.title: DatastoreOption
DatastoreOption.description:
One active datastore version, as the launch and upgrade pickers
list it.

DbAddress.title: DbAddress
DbAddress.description: One instance address, passed through as Trove sends it.

DbBackup.title: DbBackup
DbBackup.description: A backup row; ``can_restore`` marks a COMPLETED or RESTORED backup.

DbBackupDetail.title: DbBackupDetail
DbBackupDetail.description:
The backup overview. ``instance_status`` is absent when the source
instance is gone and ``parent_name`` when the backup is not
incremental or its parent is gone.

DbBackupsResponse.title: DbBackupsResponse
DbBackupsResponse.description:
The backups page; ``instances`` are the active instances a new
backup can be taken from.

DbConfigDefault.title: DbConfigDefault
DbConfigDefault.description: One effective configuration value of an instance (Defaults tab).

DbConfigurationDetail.title: DbConfigurationDetail
DbConfigurationDetail.description: The configuration group page with the instances using it.

DbConfigurationRef.title: DbConfigurationRef
DbConfigurationRef.description:
The configuration group reference Trove embeds in an instance,
passed through as Trove sends it.

DbConfigurationValues.title: DbConfigurationValues
DbConfigurationValues.description: The values a group now holds, coerced by the parameter spec.

DbConfigurationsResponse.title: DbConfigurationsResponse
DbConfigurationsResponse.description: The configuration groups page; ``datastores`` feed the create form.

DbCreated.title: DbCreated
DbCreated.description: The name of a user or database Trove accepted for creation.

DbDatabaseAccess.title: DbDatabaseAccess
DbDatabaseAccess.description: A database of the instance and whether the user may use it.

DbFault.title: DbFault
DbFault.description: The instance fault, passed through as Trove sends it.

DbFlavor.title: DbFlavor
DbFlavor.description:
A Trove flavour; ``id`` is null when rctest's Trove sends neither an
id nor a ``str_id``.

DbInstance.title: DbInstance
DbInstance.description:
A database instance row; ``actions`` are the row actions its status
allows.

DbInstanceDetail.title: DbInstanceDetail
DbInstanceDetail.description:
The instance overview. ``configuration`` is the full group when it
could be read, otherwise Trove's reference to it.

DbInstanceName.title: DbInstanceName
DbInstanceName.description: An instance as a picker or a link lists it.

DbInstanceRef.title: DbInstanceRef
DbInstanceRef.description:
The instance a change was accepted for (update, restart, detach a
configuration group).

DbLog.title: DbLog
DbLog.description: A guest log row; ``published`` and ``pending`` are byte counts.

DbLogContents.title: DbLogContents
DbLogContents.description:
The tail of a published log for the viewer. ``partial`` says older
lines exist; ``truncated`` that the viewer's size cap cut the text.

DbNetworkOption.title: DbNetworkOption
DbNetworkOption.description:
A network the launch form offers; ``classic`` marks the Nectar
classic network.

DbOptions.title: DbOptions
DbOptions.description:
The launch form's pickers. ``flavors_by_version`` is keyed
``datastore/version``.

DbParameterSpec.title: DbParameterSpec
DbParameterSpec.description: A configuration parameter of the group's datastore version.

DbResizeFlavors.title: DbResizeFlavors
DbResizeFlavors.description: The flavours an instance can be resized to.

DbRootEnabled.title: DbRootEnabled
DbRootEnabled.description: The generated root password, shown once.

DbUpgradeTargets.title: DbUpgradeTargets
DbUpgradeTargets.description:
The other versions of the instance's datastore; ``current`` is its
version now.

DbUser.title: DbUser
DbUser.description: A database user; ``host`` is ``%`` for any host.

DbUserUpdated.title: DbUserUpdated
DbUserUpdated.description: The user as Trove names it after an accepted edit.

DeleteObjectsResult.title: DeleteObjectsResult
DeleteObjectsResult.description: How many objects went, and the paths Swift failed to delete.

DeleteRequest.title: DeleteRequest
DeleteRequest.description: Object names (folders end in ``/``) to delete, folders recursively.

Ec2Response.title: Ec2Response
Ec2Response.description:
The project's EC2 pair, ``None`` when it has none; ``created`` says
whether this request made it.

ExtendWindow.title: ExtendWindow
ExtendWindow.description:
How far an active reservation can be extended. ``min_end`` is the
day after the current end; it is ``None`` when the reservation cannot
be extended at all.

ExternalId.title: ExternalId
ExternalId.description: An identity provider the account has logged in through.

Flavor.title: Flavor
Flavor.description:
A Nova flavour with the Nectar reading of its extra specs: the
flavour class, the SU rate, whether it is preemptible, and the Blazar
reservation it belongs to (``reservation_id``; ``None`` for an
ordinary flavour).

FlavorClass.title: FlavorClass
FlavorClass.description:
A flavour class the launch wizard groups flavours by, with the
number of flavours in it; ``description`` is ``None`` for a class
Hive has no sentence for.

FloatingIp.title: FloatingIp
FloatingIp.description:
A floating IP with the pool's name and the instance (or load
balancer) behind its port.

FloatingIpTarget.title: FloatingIpTarget
FloatingIpTarget.description:
A port and IPv4 address a floating IP may be associated with; the
id is ``<port id>_<address>``, unique per address.

FloatingNetwork.title: FloatingNetwork
FloatingNetwork.description: An external network floating IPs and router gateways may use.

FolderCreate.title: FolderCreate
FolderCreate.description:
``path`` is the folder's full name inside the container, with or
without the trailing slash.

FolderCreated.title: FolderCreated
FolderCreated.description: The new folder's marker object, its name ending in ``/``.

FreeSlot.title: FreeSlot
FreeSlot.description:
A free slot of a flavour, with the whole UTC days it can be
reserved for, inclusive.

Image.title: Image
Image.description:
A Glance image or instance snapshot; ``properties`` holds the
custom properties the image panel lists.

Instance.title: Instance
Instance.description: A server as the instances table shows it.

InstanceAction.title: InstanceAction
InstanceAction.description: One entry of an instance's action log.

InstanceImage.title: InstanceImage
InstanceImage.description:
The image an instance booted from; ``name`` is ``None`` when the
image is gone or not visible to the project.

InstancePort.title: InstancePort
InstancePort.description: A Neutron port on an instance with the floating IPs on it.

InstanceVolume.title: InstanceVolume
InstanceVolume.description:
A volume attached to an instance, named by its id when Cinder
cannot be read.

InterfaceCandidate.title: InterfaceCandidate
InterfaceCandidate.description:
A subnet a router may take an interface on, with its network.
``overlaps`` is the address range of a subnet already on the router
that this one overlaps (Neutron refuses the interface), else None.

KeyPairCreated.title: KeyPairCreated
KeyPairCreated.description:
A new key pair; a pair Nova generated carries its private key in
this reply only.

L7Policy.title: L7Policy
L7Policy.description: An L7 policy row; ``rules`` are ids.

L7PolicyDetail.title: L7PolicyDetail
L7PolicyDetail.description: One L7 policy with its rule rows (the policy detail page).

LaunchImage.title: LaunchImage
LaunchImage.description:
An image in the launch wizard; other projects' community images
start hidden and show only for a name search, as in the fork.

LaunchOptions.title: LaunchOptions
LaunchOptions.description:
Everything the launch wizard needs. A section that failed to load
is ``None`` and named in ``errors``; the rest still load.

LaunchRequest.title: LaunchRequest
LaunchRequest.description:
``POST /compute/instances``.

No ``availability_zone`` lets the scheduler pick one (Horizon's "Any
Availability Zone", ``launch-instance-model.service.js``). With
``create_volume`` an image or instance snapshot is copied to a new
volume of ``volume_size_gb`` that the instance boots from, as the
source step's "Create New Volume" does.

LaunchSectionError.title: LaunchSectionError
LaunchSectionError.description: Why one section of the launch options could not be loaded.

LaunchVolume.title: LaunchVolume
LaunchVolume.description: An available bootable volume the wizard can boot from.

LbInstance.title: LbInstance
LbInstance.description:
A member candidate: a project server with its fixed IPs on the
offered subnets.

LbSubnet.title: LbSubnet
LbSubnet.description:
A subnet offered for the VIP and for members: one of a network the
project may boot on.

LoadBalancer.title: LoadBalancer
LoadBalancer.description: A load balancer row; ``listeners`` and ``pools`` are ids.

LoadBalancerDetail.title: LoadBalancerDetail
LoadBalancerDetail.description:
One load balancer with its chain progress, ``None`` when no chain
ran recently.

LoadBalancerFailover.title: LoadBalancerFailover
LoadBalancerFailover.description: A failover Octavia accepted for the load balancer ``id``.

LoadBalancerFloatingIp.title: LoadBalancerFloatingIp
LoadBalancerFloatingIp.description: The floating IP on a load balancer's VIP port.

LoadBalancerFloatingIpAssociate.title: LoadBalancerFloatingIpAssociate
LoadBalancerFloatingIpAssociate.description: An existing floating IP id, or a pool (network) id to allocate from.

LoadBalancerOptions.title: LoadBalancerOptions
LoadBalancerOptions.description:
The create wizard's pickers, the project's Octavia quota and the
protocol, algorithm and L7 choices octavia-dashboard offers.

LoadBalancerTree.title: LoadBalancerTree
LoadBalancerTree.description:
Everything under one load balancer, for its detail page in one
call: monitors and L7 policies are those of its pools and
listeners.

MaintenanceWindow.title: MaintenanceWindow
MaintenanceWindow.description: A planned outage of the flavours it lists.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: A pool member (a backend address and port).

MemberAdd.title: MemberAdd
MemberAdd.description:
``nectar_dashboard/project_members/forms.py:32-45``: the username
is the account email, the role one of the two configured ids.

MemberRow.title: MemberRow
MemberRow.description:
One user and role on the Members panel. ``id`` is
``"{user_id}-{role_id}"``; nobody may remove their own rows.

MembersReplaced.title: MembersReplaced
MembersReplaced.description:
A pool's members before a replace, and how many changes (deletes
and adds) are queued; they run in the load balancer's chain.

MetadataUpdate.title: MetadataUpdate
MetadataUpdate.description:
The whole metadata of a volume or a volume snapshot: keys left out
are removed.

MostUsed.title: MostUsed
MostUsed.description: The five instances with the most SU; ``other`` sums the rest.

MyAddress.title: MyAddress
MyAddress.description:
The address the browser's requests come from, as the ingress
reports it, for a security group rule open to the user alone; None
when it is unknown.

Network.title: Network
Network.description:
A network with the Nectar classification: ``is_classic`` marks the
placeholder Nova swaps for a provider network, ``is_project`` one the
project owns. ``name`` falls back to the id.

NetworkAvailabilityZones.title: NetworkAvailabilityZones
NetworkAvailabilityZones.description:
Available zones per resource; empty where Neutron lacks the zone
extension for it.

NetworkCreate.title: NetworkCreate
NetworkCreate.description:
A new network. The MTU runs from Horizon's minimum (68) to 9000,
the largest jumbo frame; Neutron refuses one above what the network
type can carry. ``port_security_enabled`` needs the port-security
extension.

NetworkDetail.title: NetworkDetail
NetworkDetail.description: A network's page: its full subnets and the project's ports on it.

NetworkExtensions.title: NetworkExtensions
NetworkExtensions.description: Which optional Neutron features the panels may offer.

NetworkHostRoute.title: NetworkHostRoute
NetworkHostRoute.description: A subnet host route or a router static route.

NetworkOptions.title: NetworkOptions
NetworkOptions.description:
What the network, subnet, port, router and floating IP forms need.
A section that failed is None and explained under ``errors``.
``floating_ip_address_allowed`` says whether the allocate form may
offer a chosen address (``HIVE_FLOATING_IP_ADDRESS_ALLOWED``).

NetworkOptionsError.title: NetworkOptionsError
NetworkOptionsError.description: Why one section of the form options could not be loaded.

NetworkQuota.title: NetworkQuota
NetworkQuota.description:
Usage per Neutron quota resource (``network``, ``floatingip``),
only for the resources Neutron reports; a limit of -1 is unlimited.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: One ARDC news post; ``summary`` is plain text, cut to a teaser.

NodeGroup.title: NodeGroup
NodeGroup.description:
A node group. ``auto_scaling`` reads the ``auto_scaling_enabled``
label.

NodeGroupsResponse.title: NodeGroupsResponse
NodeGroupsResponse.description:
A cluster's node groups; ``can_change`` says whether the cluster's
status allows changing them.

NodeTaint.title: NodeTaint
NodeTaint.description: A Kubernetes node taint, passed through from Magnum's node group.

ObjectDetail.title: ObjectDetail
ObjectDetail.description: An object from its ``HEAD``; ``metadata`` is its user metadata.

ObjectListing.title: ObjectListing
ObjectListing.description: One page of a folder's objects and subfolders.

ObjectUploaded.title: ObjectUploaded
ObjectUploaded.description: A file streamed through Hive into Swift (the proxy upload mode).

Outage.title: Outage
Outage.description:
A Langstroth outage (``nectar/outages.py``); ``url`` is its page on
the status site.

OutagesResponse.title: OutagesResponse
OutagesResponse.description:
``available`` is false when the project's catalog has no
Langstroth; the widget then hides instead of failing the page.

ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec
ParameterSpec.description:
One field of the launch form, from Heat's ``POST /validate``.
``allowed_values`` and ``default`` keep the template's own types (a
number parameter allows numbers).

PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset
PasswordReset.description: The new API password, sent in this reply only, once.

Pool.title: Pool
Pool.description: A pool row; ``listeners`` and ``members`` are ids.

PoolSessionPersistence.title: PoolSessionPersistence
PoolSessionPersistence.description: Passes Octavia's session persistence record through.

PoolWithMembers.title: PoolWithMembers
PoolWithMembers.description: A pool in the load balancer tree, with its member rows.

Port.title: Port
Port.description:
A port; ``device_type`` is Horizon's reading of the device owner
('compute', 'loadbalancer' or the raw owner). ``device_name`` names
the instance or router behind it where a port's page or its
network's page could read it, and is None elsewhere.

PortAddressPair.title: PortAddressPair
PortAddressPair.description:
An allowed address pair: an IP address or CIDR, and the MAC address
it may use.

PortForwarding.title: PortForwarding
PortForwarding.description:
A floating IP port forwarding rule; the ports are strings because
either may be a ``start:end`` range.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description:
The user's own account on My Details, with the affiliations the
form offers and the ORCID connect and disconnect targets (``None``
when the dashboard has none configured).

ProfileUnavailable.title: ProfileUnavailable
ProfileUnavailable.description:
My Details when manuka could not be reached: why, and the ORCID
links, which need no account record.

ProxyUploadPlan.title: ProxyUploadPlan
ProxyUploadPlan.description:
The store has no TempURL support: the browser streams each file
through Hive, up to ``max_bytes``. ``objects`` is always empty.

PublicConfig.title: PublicConfig
PublicConfig.description: Settings the SPA needs before anyone logs in; none are secret.

RebuildInstance.title: RebuildInstance
RebuildInstance.description:
Rebuild from an image, optionally renaming the server and setting
a new admin password.

RecordSet.title: RecordSet
RecordSet.description:
A record set row; ``can_edit`` is false for the records Designate
manages (SOA and the apex NS).

RecordSetCreate.title: RecordSetCreate
RecordSetCreate.description:
``name`` may be relative (``www``) or absolute; empty means the
zone apex.

RecordSetUpdate.title: RecordSetUpdate
RecordSetUpdate.description:
``ttl`` omitted keeps the current TTL; ``null`` restores the zone
default.

RecordSetsResponse.title: RecordSetsResponse
RecordSetsResponse.description: The record sets of one zone, with the zone itself.

RescueInstance.title: RescueInstance
RescueInstance.description: Boot the rescue image (Nova's default when none is named).

Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description:
A reservation row. ``status`` is Blazar's lease status, kept open
for statuses a newer Blazar adds; ``status_help`` explains it.

ReservationCalendarLinks.title: ReservationCalendarLinks
ReservationCalendarLinks.description: Links that add the reservation to an online calendar.

ReservationDetail.title: ReservationDetail
ReservationDetail.description: The reservation page, with calendar links and its own address.

ReservationFlavor.title: ReservationFlavor
ReservationFlavor.description:
A reservable flavour. ``max_days`` is the longest booking in whole
days and ``rate`` its SU per hour (``nectar:rate``), ``None`` when
unset.

ReservationLimits.title: ReservationLimits
ReservationLimits.description:
The project's reservation limits. Warre counts hours; the panel
shows days. ``None`` is unlimited.

ReservationOptions.title: ReservationOptions
ReservationOptions.description:
What the create form needs. ``su_used`` and ``su_budget`` are
``None`` when the allocation is unknown, and the SU check is then
skipped; ``today`` is the UTC date.

ReservationsResponse.title: ReservationsResponse
ReservationsResponse.description: The reservations list with the limits behind the create button.

ResourceTypeDetail.title: ResourceTypeDetail
ResourceTypeDetail.description:
A resource type's schema (Heat's, passed through) and its example
template.

RestoreRequest.title: RestoreRequest
RestoreRequest.description: Restore into an existing volume, or into a new one in a zone.

RestoreResult.title: RestoreResult
RestoreResult.description: A backup restore into the existing volume ``volume_id``.

RestoreResultNewVolume.title: RestoreResultNewVolume
RestoreResultNewVolume.description:
A backup restore into a volume created for it, which ``volume``
describes.

RetypeRequest.title: RetypeRequest
RetypeRequest.description:
Change a volume's type, as Horizon's RetypeForm: the new type by
name and whether Cinder may move the volume to another backend to
apply it.

RoleChoice.title: RoleChoice
RoleChoice.description: A role the Add Member form offers: member or tenantmanager.

Router.title: Router
Router.description: A router; ``external_gateway`` is None when it has no gateway.

RouterInterface.title: RouterInterface
RouterInterface.description: A port on a router, with the role its device owner gives it.

RulePreset.title: RulePreset
RulePreset.description:
A Nectar rule preset (``SECURITY_GROUP_RULES``); ``port`` is None
for presets that open the protocol's whole range.

RulePresets.title: RulePresets
RulePresets.description:
The rule presets and the remote CIDR the rule form starts with
(empty on Nectar: the user must type one).

SecurityGroup.title: SecurityGroup
SecurityGroup.description:
A security group as listings show it: its rules counted, not
listed.

SecurityGroupDetail.title: SecurityGroupDetail
SecurityGroupDetail.description: A security group with its rules, for its page and after a write.

SecurityGroupRule.title: SecurityGroupRule
SecurityGroupRule.description:
A security group rule; ``open_to_the_world`` flags a remote of
0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 so the SPA can warn about it.

SecurityRisk.title: SecurityRisk
SecurityRisk.description:
A Varroa security risk on one of the project's resources, passed
through as Varroa sends it; the fields the SPA reads are declared.

SecurityRiskType.title: SecurityRiskType
SecurityRiskType.description: The kind of a Varroa risk, passed through as Varroa sends it.

SecurityService.title: SecurityService
SecurityService.description:
A security service row; ``type_label`` is the type as the table
shows it ("Active Directory").

SecurityServicesResponse.title: SecurityServicesResponse
SecurityServicesResponse.description: The security services list with the types the create form offers.

ServerFlavor.title: ServerFlavor
ServerFlavor.description:
The flavour embedded in a server. Nova 2.47+ embeds it by name, so
it carries no id.

ServerPassword.title: ServerPassword
ServerPassword.description:
The admin password encrypted with the key pair's public key; the
browser decrypts it, as Horizon does.

ServiceEndpoint.title: ServiceEndpoint
ServiceEndpoint.description: One endpoint of the token's service catalog in this region.

SessionTimes.title: SessionTimes
SessionTimes.description:
The token's hard expiry and the server clock, both epoch seconds,
so the SPA can warn before the session ends whatever its own clock
says.

Share.title: Share
Share.description: A share row; ``actions`` are the row actions its status allows.

ShareAccessResponse.title: ShareAccessResponse
ShareAccessResponse.description:
The manage rules page: the share and its access rules; ``can_add``
is whether the share's status lets a rule be added.

ShareExportLocation.title: ShareExportLocation
ShareExportLocation.description: Where a client mounts the share from.

ShareGroup.title: ShareGroup
ShareGroup.description:
A share group row; ``actions`` are the row actions its status
allows.

ShareGroupChoice.title: ShareGroupChoice
ShareGroupChoice.description: An available share group the create-share form can add to.

ShareGroupDetail.title: ShareGroupDetail
ShareGroupDetail.description:
The share group overview. Each of ``share_types_detail`` is the full
share type when the project can see it, otherwise its id.

ShareGroupShareType.title: ShareGroupShareType
ShareGroupShareType.description:
A share type of a group that the project's type list lacks; its id
stands in for the name.

ShareGroupSnapshot.title: ShareGroupSnapshot
ShareGroupSnapshot.description:
A share group snapshot row; ``members`` are Manila's member records
as sent and ``share_group_name`` is ``None`` where the group was not
looked up.

ShareGroupType.title: ShareGroupType
ShareGroupType.description: A share group type the create-group form offers.

ShareMetadataSaved.title: ShareMetadataSaved
ShareMetadataSaved.description: The metadata a share holds after the edit metadata form.

ShareOptions.title: ShareOptions
ShareOptions.description:
Pickers for the create forms, plus the quota state behind the create
and snapshot buttons. ``quota`` is Manila's absolute limits as sent;
``public_shares_allowed`` says whether members may make a share visible
to all projects (the deployment's setting).

ShareResized.title: ShareResized
ShareResized.description:
A resize Manila accepted; the share reports extending or shrinking
until it is done.

ShareReverted.title: ShareReverted
ShareReverted.description: A revert to the newest snapshot that Manila accepted.

ShareSnapshot.title: ShareSnapshot
ShareSnapshot.description:
A share snapshot row; ``share_name`` is filled where the share was
looked up and ``None`` otherwise.

ShareSnapshotAccessRule.title: ShareSnapshotAccessRule
ShareSnapshotAccessRule.description: Manila's snapshot access rule, passed through as sent.

ShareSnapshotChoice.title: ShareSnapshotChoice
ShareSnapshotChoice.description: An available snapshot the create-share form can restore from.

ShareSnapshotDetail.title: ShareSnapshotDetail
ShareSnapshotDetail.description:
The snapshot overview. Export locations and access rules are only
looked up, and only present, when the share supports mounting
snapshots; they are ``None`` otherwise.

ShareSnapshotExportLocation.title: ShareSnapshotExportLocation
ShareSnapshotExportLocation.description: Manila's snapshot export location, passed through as sent.

ShareSnapshotsResponse.title: ShareSnapshotsResponse
ShareSnapshotsResponse.description: The snapshots list with Manila's absolute limits as sent.

ShareType.title: ShareType
ShareType.description:
A share type and its extra specs. The create form only offers types
without ``driver_handles_share_servers``: Nectar has no share
networks.

SharesResponse.title: SharesResponse
SharesResponse.description: The shares list with the quota state behind the create button.

SignedIn.title: SignedIn
SignedIn.description:
The session probe with a session. ``expires_at`` (epoch seconds) is
the earlier of the token expiry and the idle timeout.

SignedOut.title: SignedOut
SignedOut.description: The session probe without a session: where to log in.

SlotsResponse.title: SlotsResponse
SlotsResponse.description: Free slots per flavour over the days ``start`` to ``end``.

SnapshotAccessCreate.title: SnapshotAccessCreate
SnapshotAccessCreate.description: Snapshot access is always read-write (``rw``), as in Horizon.

Stack.title: Stack
Stack.description: A stack row; ``actions`` are the row actions its status allows.

StackAccepted.title: StackAccepted
StackAccepted.description: A stack create or update Heat accepted and carries out later.

StackAction.title: StackAction
StackAction.description:
A stack action to run; whether the stack's status allows it is
checked against Heat.

StackActionAccepted.title: StackActionAccepted
StackActionAccepted.description: A suspend, resume, check or cancel-update Heat accepted.

StackDetail.title: StackDetail
StackDetail.description: The stack overview; ``parameters`` are Heat's, passed through.

StackResource.title: StackResource
StackResource.description:
A resource row. ``attributes`` (Heat's, passed through) come only
with a single resource; a list row has ``None``.

StackTemplate.title: StackTemplate
StackTemplate.description:
A stack's template and environment as Heat holds them, each also
dumped to YAML for display, and the environment as a change of
template starts from (``editable_environment_yaml``): without its
parameters, which the change carries itself, and empty when nothing
else is left.

StoreAccount.title: StoreAccount
StoreAccount.description:
The Swift account's usage. The quotas are the account metadata
headers as Swift sends them, strings or ``None`` when unset.

StoreInfo.title: StoreInfo
StoreInfo.description:
The store's capabilities and usage. ``upload_mode`` is ``proxy``
when the store has no TempURL support, whatever the setting says.

StoreObject.title: StoreObject
StoreObject.description:
An object or pseudo folder row; ``basename`` is the name below the
listed folder.

Subnet.title: Subnet
Subnet.description: A subnet as a network listing embeds it.

SubnetDetail.title: SubnetDetail
SubnetDetail.description: The full subnet, for the subnet pages and the edit form.

SubnetFields.title: SubnetFields
SubnetFields.description:
What a subnet create inside a network create carries. The IPv6
modes count only for an IPv6 subnet, as one of the pairs Horizon's
menu offers (``nectar.networks.IPV6_MODES``).

TempUrlUploadPlan.title: TempUrlUploadPlan
TempUrlUploadPlan.description:
The browser puts every file straight into Swift through signed
URLs that expire after ``expires_in`` seconds.

TemplateCombination.title: TemplateCombination
TemplateCombination.description:
The newest template for one (version, zone, driver) choice in the
create workflow.

TemplateFunction.title: TemplateFunction
TemplateFunction.description: Passes Heat's template function record through.

TemplateFunctionList.title: TemplateFunctionList
TemplateFunctionList.description: The functions of one template version.

TemplateSource.title: TemplateSource
TemplateSource.description:
A template as pasted text, a URL, or an already parsed document, plus
an optional environment and extra files.

TemplateVersion.title: TemplateVersion
TemplateVersion.description: Passes Heat's template version record through.

Topology.title: Topology
Topology.description:
What the Network Topology panel lays out: external networks first,
then the rest by name.

TopologyPort.title: TopologyPort
TopologyPort.description:
A port the topology draws. A router's gateway gets a synthetic one
(id ``gateway-<router id>``), as users cannot see the real port.

TransferAccept.title: TransferAccept
TransferAccept.description:
The id and key the giving project passed on, pasted; surrounding
spaces are dropped. The lengths are Cinder's, as Horizon's
AcceptTransferForm checks them.

TrunkOptions.title: TrunkOptions
TrunkOptions.description: Ports that may become a trunk's parent or one of its subports.

UpdateMetadata.title: UpdateMetadata
UpdateMetadata.description: Set the server's metadata: keys left out are removed.

UpgradeOptions.title: UpgradeOptions
UpgradeOptions.description: The templates a cluster can upgrade to, newest first.

UploadCompleted.title: UploadCompleted
UploadCompleted.description: The large object once its manifest is written.

UploadPlanObject.title: UploadPlanObject
UploadPlanObject.description:
How to upload one file: a single signed PUT (``url``), or segments
followed by a manifest (``manifest`` true, ``url`` ``None``).

UploadSegment.title: UploadSegment
UploadSegment.description:
One segment of a large object: the byte range of the file and the
signed URL it is put to; ``path`` goes into the manifest.

UsageInstance.title: UsageInstance
UsageInstance.description:
An instance's SU over the range. The Gnocchi fields are ``None``
for an instance Gnocchi no longer knows; it keeps its id as name.

UsageOptions.title: UsageOptions
UsageOptions.description:
The date picker's bounds: nothing is recorded before
``data_from``.

UsageRow.title: UsageRow
UsageRow.description:
A CloudKitty summary row, passed through as CloudKitty returns it;
the other keys are the ``groupby`` columns.

UsageSourceError.title: UsageSourceError
UsageSourceError.description: An upstream source the reply is missing; the reply is ``partial``.

UserDetails.title: UserDetails
UserDetails.description:
A manuka account as the helpdesk User Details lookup shows it.
``partial`` is always false here: the lookup fails instead.

UserSearchResult.title: UserSearchResult
UserSearchResult.description: A helpdesk lookup match. ``id`` is manuka's account id.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: A user's new name, password or host; at least one is given.

Volume.title: Volume
Volume.description:
A volume. ``has_snapshots`` is ``None`` when the reply did not
check (a create, or the volumes the create options offer); ``fault``
is read only by the detail of a volume in an error status, and is
``None`` everywhere else.

VolumeFault.title: VolumeFault
VolumeFault.description:
Cinder's newest user message about a volume in an error status,
such as why no backend could hold it (the Messages tab of Horizon's
volume detail).

VolumeImage.title: VolumeImage
VolumeImage.description:
The image a volume was created from, as Cinder recorded it in the
volume's image metadata.

VolumeLimits.title: VolumeLimits
VolumeLimits.description:
Cinder's absolute limits passed through by name
(``maxTotalVolumeGigabytes``, ``totalGigabytesUsed`` and the like),
with negative "used" figures raised to 0. Which names appear is
Cinder's choice, so none is declared.

VolumeMetadataSaved.title: VolumeMetadataSaved
VolumeMetadataSaved.description: The metadata a volume or a volume snapshot holds after an update.

VolumeOptionError.title: VolumeOptionError
VolumeOptionError.description: Why one section of the create options could not be loaded.

VolumeOptionImage.title: VolumeOptionImage
VolumeOptionImage.description: An active image the create volume form offers as a source.

VolumeOptions.title: VolumeOptions
VolumeOptions.description:
Everything the create volume and restore forms need. A section that
failed is empty and named in ``errors``.

VolumeTransferAccepted.title: VolumeTransferAccepted
VolumeTransferAccepted.description: A transfer this project accepted: ``volume_id`` is now its own.

VolumeTransferCreated.title: VolumeTransferCreated
VolumeTransferCreated.description:
A transfer of ``volume_id`` to another project. The receiving
project needs ``id`` and ``auth_key``; Cinder returns the key only
in this reply.

VolumeType.title: VolumeType
VolumeType.description:
A volume type; ``zones`` lists the zones its
``RESKEY:availability_zones`` extra spec limits it to, ``None`` for any
zone.

VolumeUploadedToImage.title: VolumeUploadedToImage
VolumeUploadedToImage.description: The image Cinder is writing the volume into.

Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: A zone row; ``is_transitional`` marks a PENDING zone.

ZonesResponse.title: ZonesResponse
ZonesResponse.description:
The zones page. ``quota`` is Designate's quota map (empty when it
could not be read); ``record_types`` feed the record set form.
